name: x-link-card
description: Link-card image for a page the owner controls (twitter:image for a summary_large_image card): 2:1 at 1200x600 (official: 2:1, min 300x157, max 4096x4096, under 5 MB, JPG/PNG/WEBP/GIF first frame; archived developer docs). X shows the image with a small domain label, so keep words large and central. Not needed for YouTube links: X uses YouTube's thumbnail. Brand-neutral placeholder; set twitter:image:alt (up to 420 characters).

layers.text: One line that says what the page is.
